brand_profile.product: Independent national research and consulting firm in publicly funded healthcare.
brand_profile.value_prop: Insider-practitioner guidance delivered by people who have held the buyer's exact job.
brand_profile.differentiator: Consultants who came directly from Medicaid director and senior policy roles, so they have set and defended Medicaid rates from inside agencies and plans.

segments.name: The Margin Bleed MCOs
segments.pain_buyer_perspective: A Medicaid MCO finance executive is watching medical loss ratios that do not close while the expansion population that carries premium revenue is about to shrink.
segments.systemic_condition: Acuity rose from unwinding, rates did not keep pace, and H.R. 1 now threatens the expansion population plans depend on.

edp.signal: Public earnings filings naming a shrinking expansion book and an elevated medical loss ratio.

specific_facts.fact: Molina Healthcare disclosed in its Form 10-Q an estimated 15% to 20% enrollment reduction across roughly 1.3 million expansion members.
Molina reported a medical loss ratio of 93.5%, above the level investors and analysts target.

data_sources.name: SEC EDGAR
data_sources.signal: MCO parent disclosures of rate inadequacy by state market.

segments.buyer_motivation: Rate development for 2027 begins in Q3 2026 in most states.

reasons: No Gold segment surfaced in this run; the strongest pain-qualified segment is Silver.
